purpose: validation-only teacher comparison before bulk student-data generation

generation.bos_policy: prepend one native GPT-2 EOS/BOS consistently for both models

manual_rubric_0_to_4.grammar: 3: readable complete clauses, at most one minor error; 0: broken syntax throughout
manual_rubric_0_to_4.continuity: 3: stable narrator, objects, and event progression without a factual contradiction
manual_rubric_0_to_4.voice: 3: first-person reflective/comic voice with concrete observations, not generic slogans
manual_rubric_0_to_4.repetition: 3: no repeated sentence, no recurring semantic loop, no degenerate phrase cycle

pilot_gate.required_comparison: adapted must improve voice without reducing readable/coherent stream count versus base
pilot_gate.copy_audit: report all training exact 12-word spans and longest common normalized span; review rather than silently remove difficult outputs
pilot_gate.scope_limit: passing this small validation gate only authorizes a bounded reviewed teacher-data pilot, not student or mainnet quality approval

prompts.reference: I bought the object but still had to ask permission to use it. The permission came with an update and the update came with a new rule. By the end I could not tell whether I owned a thing or had joined a very dull club. I miss the kind of object that lets you turn it on without first agreeing to a future you cannot read.
